concerns.text: FR-005 requires a Likelihood Ratio Test (LRT) to validate the knee point, but task T030 is un-checked (`[ ]`) and T029 (regression) is also un-checked. The plan assumes T031 (domain classifier) is sufficient, but the statistical validation logic for LRT is missing from the task list for FR-005.

FR-009 and US-2 Independent Test require 'REAL Qwen-Image-Agent' execution for high-complexity prompts. Tasks T021 (dispatch to agent) and T024b (generate actual images) are un-checked (`[ ]`), leaving the core hybrid comparison unimplementable.

FR-010 and Constitution Principle VII require stratified regression by visual domain. Task T031 (domain classifier) is checked, but the dependent task T032 (stratified regression logic with ANOVA/Levene's test) is un-checked (`[ ]`), blocking the required statistical validation.

Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) and FR-004 require human-verified reference descriptions. Task T006g (fetch references) is marked `[X]` in the text but the Analyze Report flags it as 'REJECTED' due to missing implementation/output. The task list does not explicitly include a 'Reference-Validator' execution step (T006b-2) as a distinct, checked task to satisfy Constitution Principle II.

FR-001 and SC-001 require a deterministic Syntactic Complexity Score. Task T015 (run_scoring.py) is marked `[X]` but the Analyze Report flags it as 'REJECTED' due to truncated script and missing output. The task list lacks a specific task to 'Validate output schema of scoring_results.csv' to ensure downstream tasks (US2/US3) can consume it.

FR-006 requires a permutation test (10,000 permutations). Task T030 mentions 'permutation test' in its description, but it is un-checked (`[ ]`). There is no separate, explicit task for the permutation test implementation, risking the omission of this critical statistical validation.

Constitution Principle V (Versioning) requires updating `state/projects/...yaml` with artifact hashes. There is no task in Phase 6 (or elsewhere) explicitly assigned to 'Generate and commit state YAML with artifact hashes' after data processing, leaving the versioning discipline unimplemented.
